C1.statement: The connection supports setting a maximum idle time.
C1.fragment: The connection supports setting the maximum idle time

C2.statement: A connection that exceeds the idle timeout will be closed and discarded.
C2.fragment: the timeout connection will be closed and discarded

C3.statement: Users can set a ping method used to check the connectivity of a connection.
C3.fragment: Support user setting `ping` method, used to check the connectivity of connection

C4.statement: An invalid connection will be discarded.

C5.statement: When the connection pool is full, connection waiting is supported.
C5.fragment: When the connection pool is full, support for connection waiting

C6.statement: Put returns a connection to the connection pool when the connection is no longer in use.
C6.fragment: Put the connection back into the connection pool, when the connection is no longer in use

C7.statement: Release releases all connections in the connection pool, when resources need to be destroyed.
C7.fragment: Release all connections in the connection pool, when resources need to be destroyed

C8.statement: Len views the number of connections in the current connection pool.
C8.fragment: View the number of connections in the current connection pool

C9.statement: The connection pool is initialized with an initial number of connections of 5.
C9.fragment: Initialize the number of connections to 5

C10.statement: The maximum idle connection count is configurable.

C11.statement: The maximum concurrent connection count is configurable.

C12.statement: Get gets a connection from the connection pool.
C12.fragment: Get a connection from the connection pool

C13.statement: A connection returned via Put is placed back into the connection pool when it is no longer in use, before it can be reused.
C13.fragment: Put the connection back into the connection pool, when the connection is no longer in use

C14.statement: When the connection pool is full, a connection waits for the pool rather than failing immediately.
C14.fragment: When the connection pool is full, support for connection waiting
